column2: Perfect! Dr. Shaft has his hands full fighting that man! Let's clean up the small fry while we can!
Incredible! Who on earth is he!?
I said I don't know, and I don't!! It's true...! Believe me!!
Stop it! He really doesn't know!
These men used my mother's body and mine for human experiments! And because of it, my mother died!\n\nI nearly died too, and ended up with a body like this!
You saw it too, didn't you? My body...! These bastards made my body like this!
I'll never let up until I've had my revenge!
Kuruma...? I feel like I've heard that somewhere...
I can hardly believe it, but... your angry face looks kind of like Dr. Kuruma's...
I look like my old man!? Don't make me laugh!
A father doing that to his own child's body... How horrible!
Now I understand why Professor Yumi condemned Dr. Kuruma...
Now I understand why Dr. Saotome said there's no end of nasty rumors about Dr. Kuruma...
He doesn't know Dr. Genzo's true terror. More importantly, you wretches... how dare you do that to my sons...!
Oh, what's this! My sons have come back to life! My sons, it's time for revenge!
Guhaaa...!\n\nN-not yet... This experiment, at least...!!
Seems some strange folks settled upriver lately... What're they doin' way out there, I wonder?
You folks headin' upriver?\n\nWell, to get upriver ya gotta go through the cave. Or else swim it, but... I wouldn't recommend that.
Herai Village is gone!\n\nDid the black moon erase Herai Village?
That way's the cave. Let's help the villagers for now.
Heh! You're here to rescue them, eh?
Aren't these the guys who attacked Herai Village? They seemed to think we came to rescue someone.
He's about to come around. He's gonna get a shock when he does!
He came to save his girlfriend and got caught by us instead...
Whoops, if we dawdle we'll miss the good part.
Looks like the Immortal Corps caught somebody.
Tried to rescue his girlfriend and got captured instead... We can't just leave him...
Looks like nobody's around the warehouse. There's a window over there... Let's get closer!
Ugh...! Dammit! The Immortal Corps got me... Huh? Ah! Y-Yukishiro-san!
Then that boy is the Shingo Shusha that Chigusa Mitsurugi and Rei Uryu mentioned?
On my way home from school, someone suddenly made me breathe anesthetic from behind... I passed out... and when I came to, I was here...
Damn it! The Immortal Corps did this!\n\n...But why would the Immortal Corps go after Yukishiro-san!?
But why would the Immortal Corps go after Yukishiro-san!?
It's because Sayuri Yukishiro is Shingo Shusha's girlfriend!

When your beloved is hurt and your heart shakes with hatred and rage...! the restraints on your reason will blow off and a colossal psychic energy will erupt. That will be the birth of a terrifying psychic!
You did this to Yukishiro-san just to awaken my psychic power...! Raaaagh!
It's no use trying to cut the chains with your powers! We're binding you with the powers of all of us!
Let's save those two...!\n\nReady...? We go on one, two, THREE!
Ready...? We go on one, two, THREE!
Damn!\n\nThe Firebird distracted us and we let Shusha's binding slip!
Anyone who tries to misuse psychic power... the power of Susano-oh... will answer to the Mitsurugi clan!
This is not misuse! It's reform! To build a new ideal society, great power is needed!
